headline: めめっち vaults from 1,112th to 22nd on ARC-2

sections.text: めめっち gained 7.09 points to reach 36.81, leaping from 1,112th to 22nd on the public ARC-AGI-2 board.
The move brings the team to 22nd on the public board.
